hierarchy.label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-foreground/60

visual_enhancers: Noise/Grain SVG filter overlay applied globally with pointer-events-none and low opacity (opacity-20).
Scroll progress hairline spanning width of the fixed header (height 1px).
Three-theme switcher toggle in the header, storing preference in localStorage.

components.Header: Fixed top, compresses height on scroll (e.g., from h-24 to h-16). Logo typography scales down slightly. Contains theme switcher (Paper/Carbon/Petrol) and mobile menu. Glassmorphism backdrop-blur.
components.Hero: Kinetic layout. H1 uses line-by-line reveal via framer-motion (overflow hidden on lines, y translates from 100% to 0). Contains layered image fragments that move at different speeds (subtle parallax).
components.ProofStrip: Horizontal flex strip showing metrics (tabular-nums count-up animations for numbers like '15+ Projects', '3 Awards').
components.CaseStudy: Grid cols-12. Left rail (col-span-12 md:col-span-4) sticky top-24. Sticky rail contains chapter navigation that highlights based on scroll position. Right side (col-span-12 md:col-span-8) scrolls vertically with artifact images in fixed-ratio (e.g. aspect-[4/3] or aspect-video) clipped frames.
components.SupportingProjects: Grid setup but deliberately unequal. First project col-span-8 with image, second project col-span-4 text-only.
components.ImpactIndex: Bento grid of stats, minimal padding, 1px border lines defining the grid (technical look).
components.Experience: Expandable accordion rows with clean borders, monochromatic.
components.Contact: Inverted tonal shift section. If Paper theme, contact is Carbon theme. Huge text. Slow horizontal marquee for email or 'Let's Talk'.

layouts.grid_system: Base 12-column grid. Generous spacing (gap-8 to gap-12).
layouts.spacing: Sections padded with py-24 or py-32. Internal container padding px-6 md:px-12.

motion.entrance: Text uses rise reveals (y: '100%'). Images use clip-path wipes (clipPath: 'inset(100% 0 0 0)' -> 'inset(0 0 0 0)').
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling. Sticky elements for the left rail in case studies. Parallax strictly limited to hero fragments.
motion.accessibility: Use useReducedMotion from framer-motion. If true, disable parallax, clip-path wipes, and marquee, and fallback to simple opacity fades.

guidelines: Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, links, toggles.
Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA (especially Petrol theme primary on background).
Provide visually hidden text for screen readers on icon buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion and @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis) for scrolling.
Implement the 3-theme switcher and store it in localStorage. Map the themes to standard Tailwind classes or CSS variables in index.css.
Ensure all images are wrapped in fixed-ratio containers (e.g. aspect-[4/3]) with object-cover and overflow-hidden.
For the hero parallax, create floating fragments (absolute positioning) and use framer-motion's useScroll + useTransform to move them slightly vertically on scroll.
For the sticky case study rail, use `sticky top-24` combined with IntersectionObserver (or framer-motion's whileInView) to highlight the active chapter in the nav.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar for small metadata (eyebrows, dates, numbers) to give an editorial tech feel.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and links.
NEVER use generic placeholder text. Use proper contextual text.
Implement the tabular-nums utility for the proof strip numbers.
Add inverted tonal shift for contact section: forcefully override CSS variables or apply the Carbon theme classes if default is Paper.
Apply `clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0)` to `inset(0 0 0 0)` for image entrance animations.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic: no uniform styling or generic centered layouts.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where required (e.g., sticky header).
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container.
Do not use AI assistant emojis.
Include subtle noise/grain textures overlay via CSS or SVG.
Ensure interactive elements have robust hover/focus states with appropriate contrast.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
